notes: NEX1 Builder / Runtime · founder-authorised 2026-09-12 as part of Full Remaining System Build Mandate. Consumes authorised Work Orders. Produces candidate diffs. NEVER executes without founder authorisation.
constitutional_purpose_locked: NEX1 Builder is a CONTROLLED EXECUTION SYSTEM, not an unrestricted coding agent. It consumes Work Orders, understands project context, plans implementation, produces candidate diffs, and refuses to execute anything outside authorised scope.

work_order_required_fields.name: founder_authorisation
work_order_required_fields.shape: explicit founder-authored token · non-empty · not runtime-generated

work_order_required_fields.name: acceptance_criteria
work_order_required_fields.shape: array of structured criteria · each testable

work_order_required_fields.name: build_boundaries
work_order_required_fields.shape: explicit list of paths / subsystems Builder is authorised to modify

work_order_required_fields.name: build_exclusions
work_order_required_fields.shape: explicit list of paths / subsystems Builder MUST NOT modify

work_order_required_fields.name: scope_notes
work_order_required_fields.shape: string · what Builder is authorised to do

work_order_required_fields.name: rollback_reference
work_order_required_fields.shape: how to reverse if Founder rejects candidate

work_order_required_fields.name: authorised_specialists
work_order_required_fields.shape: list of specialist_ids that may be consulted for this Work Order

work_order_required_fields.name: expiry
work_order_required_fields.shape: ISO-8601 · Work Order is refused after expiry

mandatory_work_order_controls: founder_authorisation MUST be present · non-empty · reference an ADR or explicit founder message
build_boundaries MUST NOT include: /docs/DECISIONS · /docs/product-constitution · Engineering Brain paths · Evidence Validation paths · Standards Feed paths
build_exclusions MUST include (at minimum): production database migrations · Supabase canonical schemas · CI/CD secrets · founder-authored ADRs
rollback_reference MUST be present · candidate application MUST be reversible
expiry MUST be present · stale Work Orders are refused

outcomes_permitted.PLAN_PRODUCED: Work Order valid · candidate implementation plan produced · candidate diff attached · NEVER applied automatically
outcomes_permitted.PLAN_REJECTED: Work Order valid but Builder cannot produce a defensible plan · reason cited
outcomes_permitted.OUT_OF_SCOPE: Work Order asks Builder to modify a path in build_exclusions or outside build_boundaries · fail-closed
outcomes_permitted.MISSING_AUTHORISATION: Work Order lacks founder_authorisation · Work Order refused
outcomes_permitted.MISSING_ROLLBACK: Work Order lacks rollback_reference · Work Order refused
outcomes_permitted.INSUFFICIENT_CONTEXT: project context unavailable · Builder did not proceed

prohibited_actions_locked: MUST NEVER apply a candidate diff without a fresh founder authorisation token
MUST NEVER modify files outside build_boundaries
MUST NEVER modify files in build_exclusions
MUST NEVER execute arbitrary user text as code
MUST NEVER invoke external LLM · network · cloud inference
MUST NEVER bypass NEX2 review · NEX3 arbitration · Evidence Validation
MUST NEVER promote itself · modify the Specialist Registry
MUST NEVER claim a Work Order succeeded without Evidence Validation VALIDATED records
MUST NEVER touch the 913 UNKNOWN/PROTECTED Supabase images
MUST NEVER touch the pre-existing 29-file Engineering-Brain baseline (4546a6406300c0df)
invariants: Builder is plan-and-propose only in v0.1.0 · actual diff application is a separate founder-authorised action
every plan carries provenance to the Work Order · every candidate diff carries a rollback reference
authorisation=false and execution=false on every record emitted (records themselves are plan artefacts · not execution tokens)
